verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents an OAuth-secured REST API covering invoices, expenses, payments, bills, journal entries and a Reports endpoint, plus an official Node SDK, so an agent could pull live ledger data to reason about affordability. However, nothing in the evidence shows a first-party agent, MCP server or AI-ready docs (llms.txt and markdown docs return 404), so the user must build the agent integration themselves. The listed report types are transactional (invoice details, payments collected, journal entries) rather than balance or cash-position statements. Missing for 10: native or official agent/MCP integration, documented balance-sheet/cash-flow/P&L report endpoints for affordability questions, AI-readable docs, and hands-on corroboration of an agent answering such questions.
